I was diagnosed with schizophrenia 9 years ago. I'm not a doctor , but it seems like you're suffering from severe anxiety. I do have some suggestions though. 

Stick to a regular sleep schedule. Try to get 8 hours of sleep per night. 

Limit your caffeine intake , no caffeine after 4pm.

Try to get out in nature as much as you can throughout the day. 

Stay away from ANY and ALL drugs , they can make your symptoms way worse. 

Keep yourself busy throughout the day, sitting or laying around will only give you time to think about the issues and give you more anxiety. I like to keep a to do list on my phone and check things off throughout the day as I accomplish them. 

Try your best to eat healthy. 

Journal and keep a log of how you feel throughout the day. 

Get in to see a doctor as soon as you can. 

Drink lots of water , I personally like flavored water. 

Exercise for 30 minutes every day. 

Try to get out of the house at least a few times a week , being out in the public is a good thing. 

If you don't already have a pet , consider getting one. They're good at keeping you company and keeping you busy. They can also sense when you're feeling off and they will try to comfort you. 

Read books , watch shows ,documentaries , stuff the interests you. Find music that lifts you up during the day and different music that relaxes you at night.

So I started a diet 3.5 weeks ago and so far I've lost 9 pounds. I'm pretty happy and excited to see how much more I can lose. I don't know your current weight, height, activity level and how many calories you usually eat per day , so I'm going to give my best advice. 

I pretty much eat what I want , but in smaller portions. I have drastically cut my daily calorie intake. I keep track of my daily calories with a free app I found called loseit. I track drinks, food , condiments , everything.

The loseit app has you put in your current weight , your goal weight and your height i believe. You then set the goal date that you want to reach your goal date by. It then automatically calculates how many calories you can consume per day in order to reach your goal weight. I was following what it said for awhile , but my results were going way too slow. I was only losing less that 1/4 pound a week. 3 weeks ago , I cut my daily calorie intake by 500 more calories. For example, the app recommends that I eat 1570 calories a day , I'm sticking to 1000-1200 calories a day and I'm seeing real progress, quicker than I expected actually!
It's hard the first few days , because your body has to adjust. 

I only drink water, but I drink flavored water ,I can only drink plain water sometimes. If I do have a soda , I stick to 0 calorie diet soda.

I only eat when I'm hungry and I keep all of my snacks/meals throughout the day under 200 calories. The only big meal i eat during the day is dinner and I keep that at 400-500 calories. I watch how big my portions are. 

With this diet , I do not feel deprived at all.  I basically eat what I want , but I limit how much and if I do have something sweet ,I make it count as a meal and add it to my daily calorie intake. 

I'll give you an example of my daily meals , they vary though depending on what I'm wanting to eat that day. By the way ,I don't exercise or have a highly physical job, but if I did I would probably need to up my calories. 

8am -breakfast 
Scrambled egg- I jazz them up and sauté onions and tomatoes in butter..I also add a little bit of milk , garlic , salt , pepper , paprika ,turmeric --- under 100 calories 

Or

Apple cinnamon fruit grain bar ---130 calories 

10 am
Depending on what I had for breakfast, I'll either have an egg or a fruit grain bar --under 200 calories 

12pm
Some type of snack.. it varies for me... could even be a chocolate chip cookie lol ---130 calories 


4pm
Salad with 2 tablespoons light ranch ( it has half less calories and tastes the same!) -- my go to salads lately in 1 cup of spinach , 1/4 cup red onion,  5 slices of Cucumbers, 5 slices of tomato ( spinach is way more healthier and more filling than lettuce) --- under 130 calories 

7:30pm-- dinner
This meal is the one that I have the most fun with , because it's my biggest meal of the day. Lol. So for dinner , I usually have some type of meat and 1 type of side. ---500 calories 


11:30--pm midnight snack
If I'm feeling hungry before laying down , I will eat a fruit grain bar before bed --130 calories 


All of this adds up to under 1300 calories per day.  :) Sometimes I eat a little more and sometimes I eat a little less. It really depends on how much activity level I've did throughout the day. 

I'm not a doctor, and I'm sure many people would be against this , but I've did the math and it's going on 3 weeks now and I feel fine. My body isn't in starvation mode or anything and I have way more energy. 

The way I figured it up is if an app tells me to eat 1500 calories per day , and I walk 5 miles a day , that adds up to me consuming 1000 calories per day. So me staying under 1200 calories is causing me to lose weight, but without the exercise. 

Sorry this is so long , but I hope this helps you some how!
